Named Claude Code and Codex account profiles

Usage: larp [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  cc  Manage Claude Code and Codex profiles

Options:
      --json                                   Emit one local metadata JSON envelope
      --expected-revision <EXPECTED_REVISION>  Refuse if the registry revision has changed
  -h, --help                                   Print help
  -V, --version                                Print version
